Examine only the attached image pixels. Do not read files, use tools, consult prior sessions, or infer obscured details. This is a Nemesis: Retaliation room tile. Report: ORIENTATION; PRINTED ROOM NAME; every game icon/symbol visible and its location, describing morphology and color before naming it; specifically determine whether any blue Item icon is present, distinguishing a blue/cyan Computer terminal icon from red/yellow/green Item icons. Mark uncertainty explicitly. Do not modify files.

[Image attached at: /home/smithers/nemesis-retaliation/assets/tts-mod/extract/v2-dl/tree/tiles/room/server-room-001.png]
[screenshot]

ORIENTATION: The Server Room tile is rotated approximately 30° counter-clockwise from upright; its title rises diagonally from lower-left to upper-right. The visible face/designation is “B.”

PRINTED ROOM NAME: SERVER ROOM

VISIBLE GAME ICONS/SYMBOLS ON THE SERVER ROOM TILE:

- Upper-left: a large solid purple letter “B” — B face/designation marker.
- Upper-right: a light-gray/white angular, three-pronged hand- or arrow-like glyph inside a dark outlined hexagonal badge — likely the Room Action/interaction symbol; exact official name uncertain.
- Right of center: a glowing cyan/blue badge containing a white-outlined monitor with a cyan screen and small base — Computer terminal icon.
- Lower-left: a red octagonal badge containing three parallel white slanted capsule/round shapes — red Item icon.
- Immediately below the red icon: a yellow hexagonal badge containing a white wrench — yellow Item icon.
- In the rules text, right of “explored”: a small cyan rectangular monitor with a white border and base — Computer terminal icon.
- In the rules text, after “without”: a light-gray cogwheel with a dark center — Malfunction symbol.

BLUE ITEM ICON: No blue Item icon is visible. The blue/cyan monitor-shaped symbols are Computer terminal icons, not Item icons. The visible Item icons are red and yellow; no green Item icon is visible.

Adjacent, mostly obscured tiles show additional partial markings—notably another large white “B” and a cropped magenta shape—but these are not on the Server Room tile, and their obscured identities cannot be determined confidently.
